decisions.reason: The GIS solution platform is close to the firm's core offer, got its own page in 2019, and underpins many other components, so it is a core asset rather than an option to abandon.

Mobile field data capture still has uncertain but real value for public and utility customers, and costs little to keep alongside platform-provider apps, so waiting for clearer evidence is preferable to dropping it.
Unlike the small plugins already pruned, the search extension was still being versioned in 2019, which signals ongoing demand at low maintenance cost within the platform ecosystem.
